messages:
maria: Heads up - Meridian wants a short scoped pilot. They specifically asked: prioritized journeys, minimal eval plan, security Qs answered, and rough cost. Deadline Fri.

josh: proposed journeys: 1) In-app FAQ assistant (contextual retrieval), 2) Order recommendation (rerank + explain), 3) Sensitive doc redaction (PII). Prioritize 1 then 2.

maria: can we keep redaction as synthetic for pilot?

josh: yes - mock redaction on synthetic data, production-grade redaction in full rollout.

tara: security: they require SSO, KMS integration, and embeddings kept in their VPC for regulated content. If pilot uses any hosted components, we need explicit consent and DPA.

samir: cost estimate for pilot (avg 4 rps, peak 15): Dedicated small recommended. Ballpark $5k/mo + burst. If Private required, add setup fee ~$25k.

maria: key success metrics: support assistant resolution >=80% on 120 seed prompts, p95 <350ms; recommender DCG difference above baseline by 10%; redaction recall 99% on test set.

sec-bot: action: upload security-pack-meridian-2036123456 (by tara).

josh: endpoints and prompt skeletons: POST /v1/help, POST /v1/recommend, POST /v1/redact. Include model_hash and citations[] in response.

maria: timeline: W1 infra + SSO/KMS, W2 ingest + retrieval tuning, W3 eval + HITS, W4 canary.

josh: will supply 10 redacted exemplar prompts.

maria: good. Next steps: josh -> prompts + eval sketch by tomorrow, tara -> complete vendor Qs in 48h, samir -> cost breakdown EOD.

samir: acknowledged.

maria: closing for now, will send the POC brief to Meridian.
